hero.title: Send Air Cargo Across Indonesia
hero.description: Ship goods and documents from Jakarta through Soekarno-Hatta Airport to your destination with an easy process. Check rates per kg now, hassle-free.

intro.heading: Air Cargo Agent from <highlight>Soekarno-Hatta Airport</highlight> for Delivery Across Indonesia
intro.paragraph1: <brand>Lion Cargo Logistik</brand> helps deliver goods and documents by air from Jakarta to destination airports across various cities in Indonesia.
intro.rate: The shipping rate is calculated <emphasis>per kilogram</emphasis> and can be checked beforehand, so the shipping cost remains clear and transparent before ordering.
intro.paragraph3: Suitable for personal needs, online stores, and businesses that regularly ship goods between cities, supported by responsive customer service via WhatsApp.

guide.heading: Shipping Goods Between Cities Becomes <highlight>Easy and Clear</highlight>
guide.paragraph1: Sending goods by air does not have to be complicated. Choose the destination city and estimate the shipment weight, then calculate the shipping cost based on the available per kg rate.
guide.paragraph2: Once confirmed, contact us via WhatsApp to arrange your shipment from Soekarno-Hatta Airport.
guide.paragraph3: This way, you already know the cost from the beginning, and your goods are delivered safely through air transportation to the destination city.

reguler.name: Regular Cargo
description: General cargo delivery through scheduled flights from Soekarno-Hatta Airport Cargo Terminal (CGK) to various destination airports throughout Indonesia.
This economical air cargo service is suitable for online store shipments, spare parts, regional commodities, and inter-island moving goods with transparent kilogram-based rates.
Supporting Port to Port and Port to Door services with safe, organized, and easy-to-monitor cargo handling.
reguler.purpose: Recommended for: Online Stores, Distributors, Spare Parts, Garments, & Moving Goods.

express.name: Express Cargo
express.tagline: Priority Loading on the First Flight from CGK
description: High-speed air cargo service with priority cargo slots on the earliest flight schedules from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.
Highly recommended for valuable shipments, urgent industrial samples, and perishable goods that require minimal handling time during transportation.
Cargo clearance is processed quickly at the terminal to ensure your shipment arrives safely with efficient delivery estimates.
express.purpose: Recommended for: Seafood, Fresh Food, Factory Samples, & Valuable Goods.

sameday.name: Same Day Service
sameday.tagline: Ship in the Morning, Arrive at Destination the Same Day
description: Express service for important documents and urgent packages from Jakarta directly to destination cities on the same day.
Packages are delivered in the morning to Soekarno-Hatta Airport Cargo agents and processed directly on the earliest commercial flight schedule.
The best solution for customers who need extreme delivery speed between islands without transit delays.
sameday.purpose: Recommended for: Tender Documents, Medical/Urgent Items, & Vital Letters/Passports.
